verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs say cloud agents can be kicked off from Slack (@cursor), GitHub/Bitbucket PR comments, and Linear. Automations also run cloud agents in response to events from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, and Linear, so all four named surfaces are covered first-party. Missing for 10: GitLab is only evidenced as an automation event trigger rather than a direct ad-hoc kickoff surface, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of the Slack, Linear, or GitHub kickoff flows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can kick off agent tasks directly from GitHub, GitLab, Linear, or Slack

citations.quote: can be kicked off from iOS, cursor.com/agents on any device (Android PWA), Desktop, Slack (@cursor), GitHub/Bitbucket PR comments, Linear, or the API
Cursor Automations run cloud agents in the background, either on a schedule or in response to events from GitHub, GitLab, Slack, webhooks, Linear, and more.
manual trigger "by commenting `cursor review` or `bugbot run` on any PR"
